name: Bank Danych Lokalnych
notes: Largest Polish local statistics DB. Anonymous access works but api_key raises limits (5→10 req/s). Header: X-ClientId.

name: Dziedzinowe Bazy Wiedzy
notes: Thematic knowledge bases. Same rate limits as BDL. Docs at api-dbw.stat.gov.pl/apidocs.

name: Składnica Danych Publikacyjnych
notes: Full public statistics — data and metadata in consistent structure. Docs at api-sdp.stat.gov.pl/apidocs.

name: System Monitorowania Usług Publicznych
notes: Public services monitoring at municipality level.

name: Strateg
notes: Regional development and social cohesion monitoring.

name: Krajowa Platforma Raportująca SDG
notes: UN Sustainable Development Goals monitoring for Poland.

name: Rejestr REGON
notes: Official Polish business register. Requires registration. Returns XML only.

name: Rejestr TERYT
notes: Official administrative division codes and names. Historical data available.

name: TranStat
notes: Experimental road and maritime transport statistics.

name: Bank Danych Makroekonomicznych
notes: Key macroeconomic indicators. No public API — file downloads only.

name: Baza Demografia
notes: Demographic data portal. File download only.

name: Bank Danych Polska
notes: Multi-sector local statistics. File download only.

name: Dekompozycje
notes: Statistical decomposition analyses. File download only.

name: Eurostat
notes: Main EU statistical office. REST API with SDMX support. No auth required.

name: OECD Data Explorer
notes: OECD macroeconomic and policy data. SDMX REST API.

name: World Development Indicators
notes: Global development indicators. Free REST API — no auth required.

name: ILOSTAT
notes: International Labour Organization statistics. SDMX REST API.

name: World Economic Outlook
notes: IMF macroeconomic data for most countries. Free API.

name: FAOSTAT
notes: UN Food and Agriculture data. Free REST API.

name: WTO STATS
notes: World trade statistics. Free API key required after registration.

name: UN World Population Prospects
notes: UN demographic estimates and projections to 2100 by age and sex.
